column1: # Complete workshop recipe grammar. Lookup-only keys, never global fragments.
# Native source: Windows x64 job-item describer 0x140a2adb0–0x140a2c60c.
# It appends independent flag prefixes, material-reaction aliases, tool-use
# labels and the shared item formatter at 0x140a82c10. Keep every constraint.
# Chinese item/material terminology follows data/runtime/local-overrides.tsv and the
# No t/h flags: these literal metadata keys are read by the recipe parser;
# its own typed captures retain every number and resolve complete item names.
# Grammar wrappers; displayed quantities have already been dimension-scaled.
Workshop recipe: format quantity with unit
# Native prefix entries carry state, material or kind roles.
# Material and category roles select the noun before states are attached.
Workshop recipe: state extract-bearing small creature
Workshop recipe: kind extract-bearing small creature
Workshop recipe: state tameable small creature
Workshop recipe: kind tameable small creature
# HOOF_TEMPLATE carries HORN for use and HOOF for display. This flag is a
# category, not the concrete horn material used in an animal's item name.
# a2b854–a2c17d: material identity, reaction classes/products and CONTAINS.
# Unknown RAW class identifiers are emitted verbatim before a space; unknown
# product identifiers precede -producing. Their typed lookup scopes are
# reaction class / reaction product, preserving the identifier's case.
# CONTAINS uses the referenced reagent NAME, not its item/material filter.
# Vanilla special aliases are listed here exactly as emitted.
